## Checklist

- [ ] Conventional Commit title.
- [ ] No audio or dictated text leaves the device without an explicit, visible opt-in, and none reaches logs.
- [ ] No code copied from GPL projects.
- [ ] Copied files are recorded in `docs/PROVENANCE.md`, and the normalized diff shows only renames and declared seams.
- [ ] Tracked docs updated where the truth changed.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` entry if user-visible.
- [ ] New controls have an `accessibilityIdentifier` and an XCUITest assertion.
- [ ] `make install` run if the app UI changed.
- [ ] No local plans, ticket files, result bundles, generated projects, ad-hoc screenshots, private tracker keys or agent-session names are tracked.
